title: Hollow Cube
description: A new way to play Minecraft maps. Play, create, and share builds and parkour, all on one server!
body:
Map Maker is a unique platform where you can browse thousands of Minecraft maps and create your own for others to play! From traditional builds to parkour, beginners to pros, there is something for everyone. We offer many custom features, such as checkpoints, timers, course leaderboards, build tools, mechanics like only sprint for parkour that reset people if they stop sprinting, custom blocks that give players items and potions effects, and more!

Play at your own pace—each map saves your progress in case you want to continue later, and new maps are constantly being uploaded for you to enjoy. Compete by climbing leaderboards and aiming for the best stats, or play casually, whatever you prefer. Get feedback and help from our welcoming community and staff, improve by seeing others' work, find other users to connect with and play or build things together, or go solo!

There is no true end goal or objective. Carve whatever path you want and have fun!
